results.title: Bruca Braca Bruda Brada - Zombie Apocalypse
results.original_title: Bruca Braca Bruda Brada - Zombi apokalipsa
results.overview: The year is 2045: humanity has almost conquered death, but some parts of the world still haven't solved the parking problem. The most powerful politician in a Sarajevo municipality has decided to implement a controversial idea and build a parking lot on the site of an old local cemetery. Of course, this is just the last straw.

results.title: New Toy Story
results.overview: When a new action figure accidentally knocks a princess doll over the backyard fence, a group of mismatched toys must work together to bring her home before dark.

results.title: Scarecrows
results.overview: Those of us who fly in airplanes probably don’t think about those who fly through Riga Airport on their own wings. But on any given day, up to 30,000 birds might visit the airport. And it would only take one… Airport wildlife control employee Mareks would like to go to church and light a candle for luck before he goes to work every day. In fact, all of us need that luck – it’s just that we’re not aware of it. Maybe that’s a good thing. Understanding wildlife that might turn up at the airport and making sure that the paths of birds, animals and airplanes don’t cross is a very real job.

results.title: CHERRY AND VIRGIN
results.overview: Erotic manga artist Ryo knows a lot about drawing sex, but when it comes to real life, he hasn't had much luck. Ami, a talented commercial illustrator who draws "boys' love" manga on the side, is in much the same predicament. The two cynical, 30-ish virgins have all but given up on romance, until they connect through a dating app and share a tentatively promising first date.

results.title: The Three Investigators: Isle of Death
results.overview: The three investigators want to go on a road trip during their vacation, but just as they are about to set off, the phone rings and an unknown caller hands the trio of detectives their latest case: the archaeologists belonging to the secret society Sphinx are carrying out illegal excavations and selling the stolen art treasures. Their next target is the supposedly cursed island of Makatao.

results.title: What Comes from Sitting in Silence?
results.original_title: What Comes from Sitting in Silence?
results.overview: From a cramped Mumbai storefront, Khatoon leads Mumbai's first women-led Islamic court. Amidst heated arguments and raw testimony, these female judges settle cases of domestic conflict, reclaiming religious law from male dominance to offer a new path toward grassroots justice.

results.title: SOIL
results.overview: Being tied to the land is not only a geographical identity, but a cultural one.  The bond between people and soil lives through ritual — their meanings eroded, traded for a symbolic value we return to in times of uncertainty.  Inspired by the Shehuo tradition, Soil explores the movement of tradition through migration — what is carried, what is altered, and what remains.  Arnaud Lin directed a film shot entirely on 16mm, choreographed and performed by Mathilde Lin, scored by Seb Forrester.

results.title: Manhunt: Cold Sun
results.overview: Landauer and Röwer track Maria Weinert, the ringleader of a global prostitution ring, to Malta following her escape from justice.

results.title: Max
results.overview: During World War II, in a sealed room, a brutal psychological duel unfolds between Jean Moulin, the leader of the French Resistance, and Klaus Barbie, the Chief of the Gestapo.

results.title: El club de la seducción
results.overview: The film follows two men with opposing personalities whose lives unexpectedly cross paths. Driven by a debt, parties, romances, and impulsive decisions, they find themselves caught up in a series of chaotic situations that blend humor, action, and romance.

results.title: Randolph Davies and the Kickass Band: The Official Concert
results.original_title: Randolph Davies and the Kickass Band: The Official Concert
results.overview: From the outrageous life of Randolph Davies comes songs about TikTok addiction, wives and lovers, Michael Jackson "did it", Dancing boat captains, a guy that can't remember his kids' names, and so much more. Randolph takes over the stage at Austin's legendary Comedy Mothership for a night of pure chaos.

results.title: The Leo
results.overview: Will this be a culmination of the past 50 years or the beginning of the next? This question looms over the town of Prescott, Ontario as the community of just over four thousand people prepare for the 50th edition of the Super Bowl of minor league hockey, "The Leo Boivin Showcase".

results.title: Tutor Emanuelle
results.overview: A caring tutor helps a man who struggles with the meaning of his life. Together, they discover the joy and beauty of life.

results.title: GW:s mord - Familjetragedin i Svartöstaden
results.overview: The morning calm in Svartöstaden is brutally shattered by a blood-curdling roar. A mother and son are found dead. In the yard, a 19-year-old is apprehended, barefoot in the snow.

results.title: Act Your Age
results.overview: Years after the cameras stopped rolling, a former child actor begins the difficult work of confronting what happened behind them.

results.title: Surname
results.overview: Marat is a young guy who dreams of becoming an architect. After his older brother becomes the city akim (mayor), the young man's life changes drastically: all previously closed doors begin to open before him on their own. However, the power of an influential surname drags him into a dangerous game, bringing him face-to-face with the criminal underworld. Now, Marat must prove the value of his own honor and dignity, rather than his famous last name.

results.title: WELP
results.overview: An aging Nova moves through desolate boxing gym as fragments of his past drift into the present. Sun-drenched memories of unconditional friendship and his deep bond with Kyra flicker against the quiet of his current world, weaving a poignant meditation on friendship, masculinity and the soft marks that time leaves behind.

results.title: One Night
results.overview: One Night is a slice-of-life look at dating in your twenties. Margaret (Rain Spencer, "The Summer I Turned Pretty") and Will (Jackson Kelly, "The Pitt") are two college students navigating the messy, magnetic space between friendship and flirtation.
